newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Los Pelambres may name partner in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Los Pelambres may name partner in Jan.

text.p: Minera Anaconda's Los Pelambres copper mine could announce the name of a foreign strategic partner by January, the mine's director said.
"There could be some news in January," Vladimir Radic, director of Los Pelambres, told Reuters.
He said the company would announce the name of the strategic partner, or a group of more than one strategic partner, but would not make public a list of front-runners.
Chilean media have said Minera Anaconda is in talks with Japanese firms Nippon Mining and Mitsubishi and Finland's Outokumpu Oy.
Minera Anaconda is looking for a partner to help finance plans to boost production at the pit to 230,000 tonnes a year by late 1998 from 23,000 tonnes last year.
Minera Anaconda is the mining division of London-quoted Antofagasta Holdings.
